messages:
maya: quick note 1: onboarded Lilac LoRA for cust-meridian yesterday with int4 quant. ran the quick-40 pack and seeing early truncation on multi-step instructions (about 4/40). not catastrophic but customer flagged one.
rishi: can you drop a failing sample id and the eval command?
maya: sample 19: prompt asks for step-by-step, answer stops after 'Step 2.'
maya: run: ```bash
./eval/quick.sh --model lilac-meridian-lora:int4 --promptset cust-meridian-40 --seed 99 --batch 4 --max-tokens 150
```
ci-bot: CI-bot: quick-run started (job 1718010005) 1 model=lilac-meridian-lora:int4 seed=99 batch=4 max-tokens=150
sophie: batch=4 on int4 may trigger a different kernel path; try batch=1 and --kv-check. also run int8 baseline for same samples for comparison.
rishi: which tokenizer did you use? cust-meridian has a small numeric-vocab patch. remap order matters.
maya: we applied remap post-merge with merge-tool v2.0; map at /mnt/merges/lilac/meridian-map.json.
rishi: ok run A/B: (A) remap-before-merge + int4, (B) remap-after-merge + int4, (C) int8 baseline. small 10-sample smoke each. I'll watch kernel selection.
maya: kicked off jobs A=1718010080 B=1718010120 C=1718010160
ci-bot: CI-bot: jobs submitted 1 IDs: 1718010080,1718010120,1718010160
rishi: also capture token logits and EOS prob for sample 19. if EOS prob suddenly spikes earlier in int4 that indicates quant shift.
rishi: pinging @runtime-bot to attach kernel info for int4 vs int8 paths.
runtime-bot: runtime-bot: captured kernel metadata for active jobs; attaching summary link: https://runtime.internal/jobs/1718010080/meta
sophie: if A (remap-first) fixes it, change merge-tool default for cust-meridian. if none fix, fallback to int8 for prod and mark int4 as experimental.
maya: A results are in: remap-first improves continuity on sample 19, B still truncates. int8 baseline is clean.
rishi: good. let's re-run whole quick-40 with remap-first + int4 and monitor Optimize alerts. add sample 19 to "cust-meridian-smoke" promptset so we get regression alerts.
maya: added sample and triggered an Optimize rule: alert if regression >1% on that set. link: https://internal.eval/ps/cust-meridian-smoke
sophie: thanks 1. can you file a small runbook step for merge-tool change and note this in the onboarding checklist? will share with solutions-eng and support.
maya: filing runbook now and will post update when full re-run completes. :white_check_mark:
